scope: Installed binary in a real PTY; one actual Engine/Job request to an authored localhost Responses endpoint. No remote model or personal credentials.

checks.name: startup has an empty composer and no new-session list item
/new stays local, focuses input and adds no sidebar placeholder
first input is visible and current before the model completes
new composer has no stale current marker and input focus is restored
starting fresh preserves the old task, question and exact unsent draft
typing a new draft neither starts a Job nor adds a placeholder
returning restores the old draft and keeps the new unsent draft
returning opens the original task verified by its complete runtime UUID

frames.step: /new opens an empty focused composer without inserting a list item
The first submitted input appears immediately as the current conversation
/new from sidebar focus returns directly to input and preserves the old task
Typing directly edits the new draft while the old conversation remains available
Old question, original draft and current title restore together
